While FDTD is well-known, correctly setting up the geometry, resolving the LSP resonance, and computing the transmission dip requires careful implementation and domain knowledge, falling under 'an established but non-trivial method needing careful implementation'.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of writing a single Python script that installs MEEP, runs two FDTD simulations (n=1.5 and n=1.51), processes the transmission spectra, and writes a JSON. It is essentially a one‑script workload with standard I/O, corresponding to '2-3 sequential steps, standard libraries only'.
